utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everyone in this courtroom and those assisting us in and outside the courtroom. Mr. Registrar would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom. This is case number IT-06-90-T, The Prosecutor versus Ante Gotovina, et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: For the purpose of continuing to hear the evidence in cross-examination, we move into closed session. And, Madam Usher, could be escort the witness into the courtroom once the curtains are down and once it is confirmed that we are in closed session.

utterances.speaker: MR. MISETIC
utterances.text: There is just one thing I'd like to advise you on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Is that to be done in closed session?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Is there any urgent matter? We went quite a bit of time beyond our usual session but it saves us to have another session this afternoon and it is on the basis of an assumption that finally would be the situation to be preferred that we continued. But I should have consulted those who assisted us. Any urgent matter at this moment to be raised.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then we will adjourn, and we will resume on Monday, the 10th of November, at 9.00 in the morning, in Courtroom I.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 10th day of November, 2008, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 4.10 p.m.,
